_note: Evaluation/calibration splits. run_eval.py --split eval drops each dataset's 'calibration' sequences from its frame maps. calibration/calibrate.py reads the 'calibration' entries. Extracted from the authors' research codebase (the calibration lists and evaluation maps of the paper's runs and the calibration protocol's notes).

co3d.eval_note: the other 40 sequences (8 categories) = the earlier protocol's co3d_eval_s0 map exactly (checked)

re10k.eval_note: the other 190 sequences = the earlier protocol's re10k_eval_s0 map exactly (checked). The paper's tables used a 38-sequence subset (re10k_eval_v2) and calibrated on 30 sequences outside it (co3d_train/re10k_train maps); those two lists were not kept in the authors' research codebase, so they cannot be reproduced exactly here.

7scenes.eval_note: test sequences (TestSplit.txt), 18 in the manifest; the paper's tables report 10 sequences, a subset that was not recorded. Calibration uses separate train sequences (dataset 7scenes_train: first TrainSplit sequence of each scene, eval/data/sevenscenes.py --split train).

tum_dynamic.eval_note: 8 fr3 dynamic sequences. Calibration uses separate takes (dataset tum_dynamic_train: walking_xyz/halfsphere/rpy_validation, sitting_xyz_validation).
